latestVersion.changelog:
Video Editor iPhone — Initial Release

- Instantly edit iPhone video clips using plain instructions (e.g., trim, add transitions, export portrait).
- Supports MP4, MOV, HEVC, M4V uploads up to 500MB; MOV files need no conversion.
- Fast cloud-based AI editing; returns edited videos in 30–60 seconds.
- Export in 1080p MP4 by default; customizable aspect ratios, overlays, and audio.
- Intuitive session and API handling—no desktop app required.
- Error handling for token expiry, file issues, and export restrictions included.
